e0-context.title: Load execution context
e0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-orchestrator.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, and the relevant Cartographer packet(s) for the bounded problem. Confirm the frozen plan's intent and scope, then attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context + glossary + relevant packet loaded; plan intent and scope confirmed

g1-implement.title: <gate name>: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for this gate: task, protected intent, test mode, close criteria, allowed scope, specific exclusions, constraints, required evidence, verification commands, authority, and the inbound map anchors from this gate's anchors block. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT as evidence: `attach g1-implement --type implementer-result --field status=<value>`, where `status` is the exact field this gate's c1 postcondition matches and `<value>` is copied verbatim from the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT's own Return status field, lowercase (`complete`, never `COMPLETE`/`Complete`) -- the engine's artifact match is exact dict equality.

preconditions.statement: <qualitative dependency on a prior gate, or none>

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers (return status complete)

structural: <struct:id — path/symbol, level — this gate lands in or depends on>
capability: <capability:id — behavior this gate changes or relies on>
constraint: <constraint:id | assumption:id — must not be silently violated>
decision: <decision:id — governs this structure; append an @grade: tag INSIDE this string so grade and decision cannot separate — e.g. 'decision:dedup-wal — reuse WAL not new journal @grade: guess · leans g1-implement · settle: 20-line spike, assert ordering'>
<decision pressure: choice this gate may force as a candidate; carries no grade — it is not yet a decision>
evidence: <claim:id or check the gate must re-confirm>
confidence_flags: <node id — low-confidence/stale/disputed area touched, and the scout/verify or decision it triggers; omit if none>

g1-review.title: <gate name>: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill templates/REVIEWER_HANDOFF.template.md: what was implemented, how to inspect the diff, task statement, close criteria, allowed scope, specific exclusions, constraints, the inbound map anchors from this gate's anchors block, and the evidence from IMPLEMENTER_RESULT. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-reviewer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned REVIEW_RESULT as evidence.

anchors.inherits: g1-implement anchors — review verifies the change against the same structural/capability/constraint/decision/evidence anchors

g1-integrate.title: <gate name>: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Check the REVIEW_RESULT verdict. APPROVE: run the verification command yourself, then advance this gate — a command-kind postcondition (like this gate's test command) is satisfied by `advance`, which re-runs the check, NOT by `attest`, which the engine refuses for command checks (only null-check and artifact conditions are attestable ahead of advance). BLOCK: send the implementer back for rework or raise a blocker if the gate is unresolvable. Log any out-of-scope finds as triage candidates.
